Global reselection chose CORE-04D because provider and future host execution need one shared durable execute-once identity/receipt/UNKNOWN/reconciliation spine instead of separate execution state machines.
CORE-04D is the only active increment. OperationJournal persists inside the canonical profile SQLite database and journals lifecycle events into canonical Activity.
Operation identity is immutable and binds idempotency key, exact intent fingerprint, explicit approval identity/source, optional Song/version and one explicit transport route for outbound work.
Outbound claim requires both a still-valid exact approval and an ALLOW transport decision for the exact prepared route. Approval does not imply connectivity and connectivity does not imply authority.
Execution may be claimed once. SUCCEEDED/FAILED/UNKNOWN are terminal for retry; UNKNOWN can later be reconciled exactly once from explicit observed evidence without erasing the original uncertainty.
No provider, DAW, socket, upload, sync, publish or mutation executor exists in CORE-04D.
Hosted exact-head execution remains accepted only when observed and is never inferred from authored tests or local semantic harnesses.
REQ-SCOPE-150 discovery/hosting and all DAW adapters remain downstream; CORE-03 closure must not reopen them by adjacency.
